assignment: Prepare a pilot decision for a distribution manager balancing damage and packing time.
source: A new insert was used on 200 nearby shipments and four were damaged. The old insert served 300 long-distance shipments and 12 were damaged. The new insert adds 20 seconds packing time. The warehouse processes 1,800 shipments daily. Long routes handle more transfers. Each damage claim ties up a support worker.

criteria.full: Computes 2% and 4% observed damage and identifies route length or transfers as confounding.
criteria.partial: Compares percentages but treats the difference as causal.

criteria.full: Converts 20 seconds across 1,800 shipments to ten working hours per day before considering staffing.
criteria.partial: Recognizes added labor without sizing it correctly.

criteria.full: Proposes concurrent randomized or matched insert comparisons within route strata and tracks packing time and claims.
criteria.partial: Proposes more shipments without controlling route severity.

criteria.full: Sets a review gate based on damage savings, labor and uncertainty with a responsible decision-maker.
criteria.partial: Recommends rollout from the raw rates or omits a decision gate.
